title: Board question: can we see every critical site right now?

scenes.headline: Can we see every critical site right now?
scenes.voice: Here is a question every board should be able to answer. Can we see every critical site, right now?

scenes.headline: Visibility, a record, and a clear owner.
lines: An audit trail of every incident
A clear owner for every response
scenes.voice: A good answer to that question needs three things. Central visibility of every site, an audit trail of every incident, and a clear answer to who responds when something happens.

scenes.headline: Make the answer provable.
scenes.voice: FOG Technologies Nexus builds the cameras, links and control room that make that answer possible, and documents them so your team can prove it.
